blocker.observedError: Scenario cannot be run because its organization or team is paused. Resolve the exceeded operations or data transfer limit and try again.
blocker.rootCause: Make organization/team execution is paused by an exceeded operations or data-transfer limit. The canonical scenarios exist, but runtime mutation is refused before the learning route can execute.
blocker.preventionRule: Do not retry a known Make team/org capacity pause. Persist one deduped open outcome obligation and replay once after direct evidence shows execution is available again.

preconditions: Read current Make organization/team execution state before mutation.
Do not replay while the same capacity blocker is still present.
Submit each event with its stable fingerprint through BG168 so BG166 dedupe remains canonical.
After writes, refresh/read BG167 and prove the fingerprints are visible to subsequent agents.
If an event is already present, accept the BG166 dedupe/no-action result rather than creating a duplicate.

events.symptom: Supabase password auth, RLS and offer reads were healthy while editable login fields inside the large legacy portal repeatedly re-rendered or jittered on iOS and could not reliably receive input.
events.rootCause: Authentication ownership was split across legacy Netlify Identity control, Supabase customer auth and legacy portal render/lifecycle code. Backend HTTP 200 did not prove a usable device UI outcome.
events.failedApproach: Repeated inline-field patches; only bypassing Netlify Identity; only changing reload/direct-open; persistence alone while fields remained in the legacy re-rendering DOM; treating backend 200 or Netlify READY as device proof.
events.fix: Use klant-login.html as the single editable customer-auth boundary; Supabase password/magic-link auth plus RLS; persist session outside legacy inline lifecycle; unauthenticated legacy toonInlog redirects to isolated login; return to the same customer slug and preserve offer/sprint portal.
events.preventionRule: When backend auth/data is green but legacy editable auth UI is unstable, stop stacking symptom patches, identify competing auth/render owners, isolate auth behind one stable boundary, and close mobile/iOS incidents only with device outcome evidence.
events.regressionContract: tests/customer-portal-auth-race.test.mjs plus verifyCustomerLoginContract() and canonical customer-login architecture contract.

events.symptom: Shared Agent Memory CI ran for automation branches and pull requests to main but not for direct pushes to main, allowing memory-contract changes to land before the memory suite ran.
events.rootCause: The workflow trigger did not include main under push branches.
events.failedApproach: Treating PR-only/automation-only validation as complete production governance and assuming documentation references alone protected the memory contract.
events.fix: Run Shared Agent Memory Tests on direct main pushes as well as candidate branches and PRs, and regression-test the workflow trigger.
events.preventionRule: Every material memory-contract mutation must have a candidate gate and a post-merge/main gate; post-push CI is detection after ref mutation, not native pre-write protection.
events.regressionContract: tests/development-doc-contract.test.mjs validates main push coverage and the shared memory workflow executes the contract suite.

events.symptom: A manual GitHub connector write without an explicit branch can fall back to the default branch even though NEVER_TDD_DIRECTLY_ON_MAIN already exists as policy.
events.rootCause: Authorized connector capability was treated as governed delivery while GitHub main had no native protection enforcement. Branch omission therefore bypassed the intended candidate/PR route.
events.failedApproach: create_file/update_file with branch omission or main target followed by successful post-push CI as if that proved prevention.
events.fix: Read current main, create a fresh non-main candidate branch, pass it explicitly to every material write, perform RED/GREEN only on candidate SHAs, run Unified BRAIN, promote exact tested head, and read main back.
events.regressionContract: Machine learning/preflight plus canonical checkpoint and development ledger retain the candidate-only rule and platform-enforcement boundary.

events.symptom: While appending a new learning, a full-file ledger rewrite accidentally changed an existing historical Netlify deploy ID. PR diff review caught the mutation before merge and the historical value was restored.
events.rootCause: Append-only operational memory was updated using a broad full-file replacement without a machine gate that explicitly forbade modifications to prior evidence records.
events.failedApproach: Assuming a semantically small documentation change is safe when the transport replaces the complete append-only file, and relying only on content-presence tests rather than historical immutability checks.
events.fix: Treat prior ledger/event/evidence records as immutable; append new entries or create explicit superseding/correction records; inspect the final diff for historical mutations before promotion and restore any accidental changes before rerunning exact-head gates.
events.regressionContract: Brain persistence invariant I205: no append-only usage/evidence/event correction via destructive overwrite; add focused immutable-history regression coverage when the ledger writer is changed.

events.symptom: Canonical BG168 runtime writeback was refused because the Make organization or team is paused after exceeding operations or data-transfer capacity.
events.rootCause: External Make capacity state prevents scenario execution; this is not an application logic failure and not evidence that the canonical writeback route is missing.
events.failedApproach: Retrying the same mutating scenario while capacity remains paused, or claiming repository/chat continuity equals completed BG166/BG167 runtime writeback.
events.fix: Persist this deduped outcome obligation, stop retries while blocked, and replay exactly once through BG168 after direct capacity recovery evidence, followed by BG167 readback.
events.regressionContract: tests/chat-runtime-brain-writeback-guard.test.mjs keeps the blocker, canonical route, dedupe and readback completion contract machine-readable.
